details:
- Rebuild with golang 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix the following CVEs
  - CVE-2026-33818: enforce a maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1
    Unmarshal to prevent stack exhaustion on deeply nested structures
  - CVE-2026-56859: add a recursion depth guard in encoding/xml so that
    DecodeElement no longer resets the depth counter
  - CVE-2026-56858: track the JavaScript regexp context in html/template so
    a pathological input cannot close an unescaped '/' early
  - CVE-2026-56860: avoid quadratic complexity in net/url resolvePath by
    resolving ".." segments with index-based backtracking
  - CVE-2026-56862: do not count handshake messages as state-advancing after
    the crypto/tls handshake has completed, bounding KeyUpdate key derivation
